florentino.warningBody.0: The chairman is warming up his right hand. Consider this a friendly reminder.
florentino.warningBody.1: The board met this morning. Nobody said your name. That's actually worse.
florentino.warningBody.2: Word from the boardroom: they are 'monitoring the situation closely'. You know what that means.
florentino.warningBody.3: The chairman has started looking up your replacement. Don't make it easy for him.
florentino.warningBody.4: The fans are restless. The board is restless. The groundskeeper is oddly calm.
florentino.warningBody.5: You scraped through this time. But the sword of Damocles is swinging.
florentino.warningBody.6: The chairman's PA just called. He didn't say why. He didn't have to.
florentino.warning2Body.0: This is your LAST chance. One more bad result and you're clearing your desk. Florentino is not joking.
florentino.warning2Body.1: The board has made its decision. You have one final opportunity to turn this around. Use it.
florentino.warning2Body.2: Florentino is on the phone. He says nothing. You hear him breathing. That's the warning.
florentino.firedBody.0: The board has terminated your contract. A press release will follow shortly. It will be diplomatic.
florentino.firedBody.1: The chairman's hand has spoken. Security will escort you to your car.
florentino.firedBody.2: You have been sacked with immediate effect. Your parking permit is also revoked.
florentino.firedBody.3: The board lost confidence. The fans lost patience. The chairman lost your number — on purpose.
florentino.okBody.0: Florentino looked at the results. Closed his laptop without slamming it. That's progress.
florentino.okBody.1: Someone in the boardroom said 'well...' in an almost positive tone. Don't push it, but don't ignore it either.
florentino.okBody.2: The chairman's PA no longer sighs when your name comes up. Small victories.
florentino.okBody.3: The chairman says you're 'heading in the right direction.' In football terms, that means he's not actively looking for your replacement. Sort of.
florentino.okBody.4: The board gives you a pass. In Florentino terms, that's basically a distinction for the rest of the world.
florentino.praiseBody.0: The chairman smiled at the weekly report. That doesn't happen often. Enjoy it.
florentino.praiseBody.1: Word from the boardroom: they are pleased. There may even be a bonus coming. Key word: may.
florentino.praiseBody.2: The fans are happy. The board is happy. Even the groundskeeper is smiling now.
florentino.praiseBody.3: The chairman mentioned your name in a positive sentence. Frame that. It won't happen twice.
florentino.marbellaBody.0: Florentino is on the phone. 'Listen,' he says, 'I'm giving you Marbella. All of it. You've earned it.' The squad get a bonus too — morale is through the roof. €2M transferred to the club.
florentino.marbellaBody.1: 'You know what,' says Florentino, 'like they say in Torrente — this is beautiful.' He wires €2M to the club and has watches delivered to every player. Stamina is at maximum.
florentino.marbellaBody.2: The chairman calls from his yacht. 'We are unbeatable. Gifts for the boys, money for the club, and Marbella for you, mi amor.' €2M hits the account. Players are flying.
florentino.firedBody: The board has lost all confidence in your management. Your contract has been terminated.

tutorial.title: PRO MANAGER — HOW TO PLAY
tutorial.welcome: Welcome, {name}. Here's what you need to know.
tutorial.obj1: The board assigns you a seasonal objective: win the league, finish top 4, top half, or avoid relegation.
tutorial.obj2: Meet it and the board stays happy. Fail it and the pressure builds.
tutorial.obj3: Win trophies and manage multiple clubs to build your reputation.
tutorial.flo1: The board meter (0–10) tracks how the president sees you — starts at 5.
tutorial.flo2: It rises with wins, clean sheets, goals scored, and good results vs stronger teams.
tutorial.flo3: It drops with losses (especially at home vs weaker sides), red cards, and heavy defeats.
tutorial.flo4: If it drops below 2 the board may fire you. Warnings appear in the status bar.
tutorial.rep1: Your personal reputation persists across clubs and seasons — starts at 50.
tutorial.rep2: It grows with wins, trophies, and improving squad value. It decays with bad seasons or being fired.
tutorial.rep3: Higher reputation = better job offers from bigger clubs. You can see it in the career screen.
tutorial.tra1: The market opens for 10 jornadas at the start of the season and 8 jornadas at mid-season.
tutorial.tra2: List players in your squad to attract offers from rival clubs.
tutorial.tra3: Rival teams can trigger a release clause (clausulazo) on your best unlisted players during an open window.
tutorial.fin1: Your budget covers wages each jornada. Gate revenue from home matches adds income.
tutorial.fin2: Track income, salaries, squad value, and transfers in the Finances screen.
tutorial.tip: Tip: check the Finances screen for the full transfer history and the Career screen to export your save.
engine.intro: Tune every game-balance constant. Defaults represent the intended experience. Changes take effect on the next relevant event.
engine.footer: Settings are saved automatically and persist across sessions. These are not difficulty presets — they are raw engine knobs. Combine them thoughtfully.
engine.offerInsultThreshold.label: Insulting-offer threshold
engine.offerInsultThreshold.desc: Offers below this share of asking price are treated as insulting.
engine.offerInsultThreshold.tip: Lower = clubs accept smaller bids. Higher = brutal negotiations.
engine.offerInsultBlockProb.label: Insult-block chance
engine.offerInsultBlockProb.desc: Chance an insulting offer locks the player out for the season.
engine.offerInstantAcceptMult.label: Instant-accept multiplier
engine.offerInstantAcceptMult.desc: Price multiplier guaranteeing an automatic acceptance (no negotiation).
engine.offerRejectBlockProb.label: Rejection-block chance
engine.offerRejectBlockProb.desc: Chance a reasonable but rejected offer closes the door for the season.
engine.offerNegotiationRange.label: Negotiation range
engine.offerNegotiationRange.desc: Width of the random acceptance window. Higher = more unpredictable.
engine.clausulazoMult.label: Buyout-clause cost
engine.clausulazoMult.desc: Price multiplier to trigger a release clause.
engine.clausulazoMult.tip: 2× by default. Raise to make buyouts more expensive.
engine.transferPriceMult.label: Market inflation
engine.salaryMult.label: Salary multiplier
engine.ticketRevenueMult.label: Ticket-revenue multiplier
engine.agePeakBonusMult.label: Prime-age bonus
engine.agePeakBonusMult.desc: Price multiplier for young players in their prime.
engine.reputationGainMult.label: Reputation gain
engine.reputationGainMult.desc: Multiplier on reputation gained from good results.
engine.reputationLossMult.label: Reputation loss
engine.reputationLossMult.desc: Multiplier on reputation lost to bad results and firings.
engine.homeAdvantageMult.label: Home advantage
engine.matchScreenMaxWidthPx.label: Match screen max width
engine.matchScreenMaxWidthPx.desc: Maximum width (px) of the live-match panel. Default 1800.
engine.meterWinBase.label: Win Reward
engine.meterWinBase.desc: Base florentinómetro gain per victory (before context adjustments).
engine.meterWinBase.tip: Context bonuses stack on top: upset wins, dominant wins, and clean sheets add extra. This is just the floor.
engine.meterDrawBase.label: Draw Impact
engine.meterDrawBase.desc: Base florentinómetro change for a draw. Zero = draws are neutral; negative = board expects wins.
engine.meterDrawBase.tip: Drawing against a much stronger team still gives a bonus on top of this base value.
engine.meterLossBase.label: Loss Penalty
engine.meterLossBase.desc: Base florentinómetro drop per defeat. Losses against much stronger teams are partially forgiven on top of this.
engine.meterLossBase.tip: Losing to a clearly better team? The engine adds a forgiveness bonus — but this base is still deducted.
engine.meterWeeklyPositive.label: Weekly Positive Drift
engine.meterWeeklyPositive.desc: Meter gain each jornada when the club's weekly finances are in the black (income > salaries).
engine.meterWeeklyPositive.tip: Keeping a healthy budget makes the board happy, independent of results.
engine.meterWeeklyNegative.label: Weekly Negative Drift
engine.meterWeeklyNegative.desc: Meter drop each jornada when the club runs a weekly loss (salaries > income).
engine.meterWeeklyNegative.tip: Big squads or high wages will hurt the board meter every jornada you're in the red.
engine.boardKeepThreshold.label: Board Loyalty Threshold
engine.boardKeepThreshold.desc: Meter score at which the board starts seriously considering keeping you at season end.
engine.boardKeepThreshold.tip: Above this threshold = 60% chance you stay. Below it, the chance drops exponentially — a meter of 0 means near-certain firing. Raise this to make boards harder to please, lower it to get more job security.
engine.goalChanceMult.label: Goal Rate
engine.goalChanceMult.desc: Multiplier on the base goal probability per attacking chance.
engine.goalChanceMult.tip: At 1×, a balanced duel has roughly a 22% goal chance. 2× doubles that, leading to higher-scoring games. 0.5× makes defenses much more dominant.
engine.injuryMult.label: Injury Frequency
engine.injuryMult.desc: Multiplier on per-minute injury probability (base: ~0.025% per player per minute).
engine.injuryMult.tip: At 2×, you can expect roughly twice as many injuries per match. At 0× injuries are disabled. Squad depth matters more at higher values.
engine.staminaDecayMult.label: In-Match Fatigue
engine.staminaDecayMult.desc: How fast players lose stamina during a match. Affects substitution decisions and late-game performance.
engine.staminaDecayMult.tip: High physical stats reduce decay naturally. At 2×, substitutions and rotation become critical. At 0.5×, players tire very slowly.
engine.staminaRecoveryMult.label: Stamina Recovery
engine.staminaRecoveryMult.desc: How much stamina players recover between jornadas (base: 12–25 points depending on physical stat).
engine.staminaRecoveryMult.tip: At 2×, players are nearly full every match. At 0.5×, you must rotate heavily to avoid fielding exhausted lineups. Pairs with In-Match Fatigue.
engine.firingRiskMult.label: Firing Risk
engine.firingRiskMult.desc: Multiplier on all mid-season firing probabilities. 1× = default; 2× = board fires twice as fast; 0× = no mid-season firing possible.
engine.firingRiskMult.tip: At 0× the board can never fire you during the season regardless of meter level — useful for casual play. At 2× you'll be dismissed very quickly at low meter values.
engine.seasonObjectiveBonus.label: Objective Bonus
engine.seasonObjectiveBonus.desc: Board meter gain applied at season end when you meet the board's objective.
engine.seasonObjectiveBonus.tip: Stacks on top of everything accumulated during the season. A high bonus means meeting the objective carries real weight even after a rough run.
engine.seasonObjectivePenalty.label: Objective Penalty
engine.seasonObjectivePenalty.desc: Board meter drop applied at season end when you miss the board's objective.
engine.seasonObjectivePenalty.tip: A steep penalty makes finishing below the objective very dangerous for your job security — even if your in-season meter was healthy.
engine.transferGoodDelta.label: Good Transfer Bonus
engine.transferGoodDelta.desc: Board meter bonus for smart transfers: buying young players at fair value, or offloading aging ones profitably.
engine.transferGoodDelta.tip: Good transfer = buying under-peak player at ≤110% market value, or selling an old player at ≥80% of market value.
engine.transferBadDelta.label: Bad Transfer Penalty
engine.transferBadDelta.desc: Board meter drop for poor transfers: overpaying for old players or selling young stars too cheaply.
engine.transferBadDelta.tip: Bad transfer = overpaying for a past-prime player, or selling a young high-media player below 80% of market value.
engine.cardStrictness.label: Referee Strictness
engine.cardStrictness.desc: Scales yellow and red card thresholds. Higher = more cards, more red-card ejections, shorter-tempered officials.
engine.cardStrictness.tip: Cards trigger suspensions — more cards means more games missed. Pair with high strictness to make discipline a real factor in squad management.
engine.possessionDiffExp.label: Possession Dominance
engine.possessionDiffExp.desc: Exponent controlling how strongly a quality gap between teams affects possession distribution.
engine.possessionDiffExp.tip: At 1×, a slightly stronger team barely dominates possession. At 4×, a big quality gap means the weaker team barely touches the ball. Default 2.5 is realistic.
engine.matchEventRate.label: Match Event Rate
engine.matchEventRate.desc: Per-minute probability of any event occurring (shots, cards, injuries). Higher = more action per match.
engine.matchEventRate.tip: At 0.5 roughly half of all minutes will have some event. Combine with Goal Rate to tune match intensity.
engine.assistRate.label: Assist Rate
engine.assistRate.desc: Fraction of goals that have a registered assist. Affects statistics only, not the match outcome.
engine.assistRate.tip: At 100% every goal has an assist (when a teammate set it up). At 0% no assists are ever registered.
engine.oopPenalty.label: Out-of-Position Penalty
engine.oopPenalty.desc: Effectiveness multiplier for outfield players playing at an incorrect position.
engine.oopPenalty.tip: At 0.825 (default) an out-of-position player performs at ~82.5% of their normal effectiveness. Lower values punish mismatches harder.
engine.gkOopPenalty.label: GK Out-of-Position
engine.gkOopPenalty.desc: Effectiveness multiplier for an outfield player forced to play as goalkeeper (e.g. after a GK red card).
engine.gkOopPenalty.tip: At 0.45 (default) a field player in goal operates at 45% effectiveness — very dangerous. Raise it to make emergency goalkeepers less catastrophic.
engine.moodLineupBonus.label: Lineup Mood Bonus
engine.moodLineupBonus.desc: Mood score bonus for players who are in the starting XI. Higher values make starters happier relative to bench players.
engine.moodBenchPenalty.label: Bench Mood Penalty
engine.moodBenchPenalty.desc: Mood score penalty for players with appearances who are not in the current starting XI.
engine.moodBenchPenalty.tip: Players with zero appearances are not affected. Pairs with Lineup Mood Bonus to control the mood gap between starters and squad players.
engine.aiClausulazoProb.label: AI Clausulazo Chance
engine.aiClausulazoProb.desc: Per-jornada probability that a rival club activates a buyout clause on one of your players.
engine.aiClausulazoProb.tip: Only affects players with a high enough media rating. At 5% (default) you'll see roughly one clausulazo per transfer window. Raise this for a more chaotic, aggressive market.
engine.aiTradeProb.label: AI Trade Activity
engine.aiTradeProb.desc: Probability that AI teams swap bench players with each other each jornada.
engine.aiTradeProb.tip: AI trades affect squad depth across the league, making rival teams stronger or weaker in specific positions. Disable (0%) for a static transfer landscape.
engine.aiSigningProb.label: AI Signing Activity
engine.aiSigningProb.desc: Probability per jornada that an AI team signs a listed player or free agent.
engine.aiSigningProb.tip: High values mean rivals actively build stronger squads and the free agent pool empties faster. Low values make the market more predictable — good players stay available longer.
